FORM 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1)

AMENDED FILER CORP.

Item 1.05 Material Cybersecurity Incidents.

This Amendment No. 1 to the Current Report on Form 8-K originally filed on April 1, 2026 updates the Company's prior disclosure regarding a cybersecurity incident.

The Company's continuing investigation has confirmed that the threat actor exfiltrated additional customer data beyond the scope described in the original filing. The Company now believes the incident is reasonably likely to have a material impact on its results of operations.
